name: Ayanna Pressley
page_title: Ayanna Pressley's Issue Positions (Political Courage Test)
on_the_ballot: Running, Democratic for U.S. House (MA) - District 7

positions.question: Do you support the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade?

evidence.text: Rated 100% by Planned Parenthood Action Fund

"Ayanna is co-chair of the Abortion Access Task Force and has co-led legislation, now passed twice in the House, to protect and restore access to abortion care nationwide. Abortion care is healthcare and an essential human right. Ayanna has continued to organize, legislate, and push back against the cruel attempts to tear away bodily autonomy and necessary healthcare. She has also successfully expanded access to abortion medications and birth control and worked closely with the Secretary of Health and Human services to use every tool available to protect families and providers who need abortion care. Everyone in this nation should have access to the care they need."

"This pro-choice majority Congress must be more than a talking point. It's time to codify Roe and affirm abortion care as the fundamental human right it is. Our humanity, our collective liberation, & our lives are at stake."
Rated 100% by NARAL Pro-Choice America

positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Social Security provides a critical safety net for our seniors and community members with disabilities. We cannot let these funds run out. We must ensure Social Security is adequately funded and protected for generations to come."
"While Democrats fight hard to expand Medicare and Social Security, Republicans want to slash them. The cruelty is the point."
Rated 100% by Alliance for Retired Americans
Rated 100% by National Committee to Preserve Social Security and Medicare

positions.question: Do you support the regulation of indirect campaign contributions from corporations, unions, and individuals?

evidence.text: "John Lewis, may he rest in peace & power, dedicated his life to advancing civil rights & protecting our sacred right to vote. We must honor his legacy by abolishing the filibuster & passing the John Lewis Voting Rights Act & For The People Act. Our democracy depends on it."
Rated 92% by End Citizens United
Voted in favor of H.R. 1 "For the People Act of 2021"

positions.question: Do you support protecting government officials, including law enforcement officers, from personal liability in civil lawsuits concerning alleged misconduct?

evidence.text: "End qualified immunity."

"Qualified immunity allows law enforcement to evade accountability. If a police officer kills a person, at the very least, they must be held accountable. We need to pass my bill to end qualified immunity."

"Qualified immunity is a barrier to accountability & healing & we must dismantle it at all levels of government. I urge the @MA_Senate to preserve the provisions on qualified immunity in the Reform, Shift and Build Act. We will not be intimidated & we will not back down."
Voted in favor of H.R. 7120 "George Floyd Justice in Policing Act of 2021"

positions.question: Do you support increasing defense spending?

evidence.text: "Policy violence is when the richest country in the world spends over $700B annually on its military but does not guarantee affordable housing, childcare, or healthcare for its people."
Voted against HR 2670: "National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024"
Voted against HR 4365: "Department of Defense Appropriations Act, 2024"
Voted against S. 1790 "The National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2020"

positions.question: Do you support federal spending as a means of promoting economic growth (e.g. grants, tax incentives)?

evidence.text: "Ayanna has introduced Federal Job Guarantee legislation that would make good wages, strong benefits, union protections, and safe working conditions a legal right in America. Funded by the federal government and implemented locally, in partnership with communities, federal job guarantee projects would provide public jobs for all adults seeking employment – because the people deserve true economic justice."
"The #BuildBackBetter Act would relieve millions of families, deliver critical investments in our communities, jumpstart the economy & is key to a just and equitable recovery. Full stop."
Voted in favor of H.R. 5376 "Build Back Better Act."
Voted in favor of H.R. 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government increasing funding for affordable housing programs?

evidence.text: "Ayanna has used her position on the Financial Services Committee to press for increased federal investments in our housing stock and taken bad actors to account. She organized and legislated to successfully extend the federal eviction moratorium three times during the pandemic. Ayanna will continue to advocate for sustainable, robust housing investments to end our intergenerational housing crisis and make affordable, high-quality housing more accessible and attainable for people and families across the Massachusetts 7th."

"Public housing is a lifeline for millions of families. But the chronic underfunding of public housing is a disgrace to our values and has real consequences. Republicans can and must join us in taking action to improve the quantity and quality of public housing."
Voted in favor of HR 7301 "Emergency Housing Protections and Relief Act of 2020"
Voted in favor of HR 8294 "Transportation, Housing and Urban Development, and Related agencies Appropriations Act"

positions.question: Do you support the federal government taking action, beyond those of the Federal Reserve, to alleviate inflation?

evidence.text: "Boston is now the second most expensive city to rent in, where the median rent for a one-bedroom apartment is over $3,000. This is a crisis. We need bold investments in affordable housing & immediate solutions like rent stabilization to address inflation & lower housing costs."
Voted in favor of H.R. 4521 "America COMPETES Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of H.R. 5376 "Inflation Reduction Act of 2022"
Voted in favor of H.R. 7688 "Consumer Fuel Price Gouging Prevention Act"

positions.question: Do you support the forgiveness of federal student loan debt?

evidence.text: "Ayanna has spent years pressing for student debt cancellation and, in partnership with Senator Warren, Congressional colleagues, and a dedicated coalition of advocates and borrowers, has effectively secured Presidential action to cancel billions of dollars in debt for millions of borrowers in Massachusetts and across the nation."
"Student loan borrowers are facing crushing debt, and they deserve and demand relief. We can and must deliver."

"Student loan debt is a nearly $1.7 trillion crisis that disproportionately impacts Black communities. We have a critical opportunity to champion economic & racial justice with broad-based debt cancellation — and we cannot miss this moment."

"Student loan debt is an intergenerational issue of racial & economic justice. Debt cancellation would help to close the racial wealth gap & liberate millions from this crushing burden. Let’s get it done"

evidence.text: "Climate change is real—full stop. We must divest from fossil fuels. That’s why @RepMondaire, @RepRashida, and I introduced the Fossil Free Finance Act to move us toward renewable and clean energy. This is the only Earth we have. We must act urgently to protect it."

"I am proud to continue supporting a #GreenNewDeal and to continue rejecting donations from #FossilFuel companies. TY to the bold, visionary citizen activists who are taking #action to stop climate change and to build a more sustainable future for generations to come."

positions.question: Do you support a government-run (e.g. single-payer) healthcare program, such as Medicare-for-All?

evidence.text: "Ayanna believes we need Medicare For All to ensure that every person in our country has consistent access to essential care. We need to improve health outcomes for communities that are simultaneously impacted by health disparities and overlooked in our national conversations around healthcare access. We need to continue to invest in community health centers. And we need to keep advocating and legislating for an equitable public health response to the COVID-19 pandemic, that includes those suffering from Long COVID."

"If you’re poor, Black, brown, indigenous or disabled, your ability to live & survive in America is jeopardized by a broken healthcare system that puts profit over people. Healthcare is a human right. We need #MedicareForAll."

"In the richest nation in the world, it's a shame that there are 28 million people who don't have health insurance. Proud to join @RepJayapal, @SenSanders, & @RepDebDingell in re-introducing #MedicareForAll to affirm health care as the human right that it is."

"Your reminder that health care is a fundamental human right and no one should have to choose between getting essential care or going into debt — especially in the richest country in the world. It’s time for #MedicareForAll."

positions.question: Do you support expanding paid family AND/OR medical leave benefits (e.g. maternity leave)?

evidence.text: "Pregnancy loss should be met with compassion, care, resources, research, & paid leave. Pass it on."
"Say it with me: every worker deserves paid sick leave. Denying them this right is an affront to workers everywhere."
"The fact that the U.S. has 0 weeks of guaranteed paid leave is shameful. We can & must change that in the #BuildBackBetter Act."
Voted in favor of H.R. 6201 "Families First Coronavirus Response Act"

positions.question: Should the government be able to regulate the cost of prescription drugs?

evidence.text: "@HouseDemocrats fought hard to cap insulin at $35/month for Medicare beneficiaries. Now, even more people with diabetes will feel this relief. This will save lives and is a testament to the power of our collective advocacy."

"No one should have to choose between paying for their insulin or feeding their families. I’m proud to join @RepCori & @SenSanders' #InsulinForAllAct to cap insulin prices at $20 & stop the egregious price-gouging by Big Pharma."
Voted in favor of H.R. 3 "Lower Drug Costs Now Act of 2019"
Voted in favor of H.R. 6833 "The Affordable Insulin Now Act"
